goal: Workstream: regression test matrix for the arch-toolkit v0.3.0 migration. Prerequisite: current branch is feat/arch-toolkit-v0.3.0-migration; inspect the repository, Cargo configuration, main...HEAD diff, test directories, and test helpers. Goal: produce an implementation-ready test matrix split into unit, integration, and end-to-end/CLI or runtime-flow layers, prioritizing failures that could be introduced by replacing local logic with arch-toolkit adapters. Non-goals: do not edit project/source files, do not propose broad refactors, do not run subagents. Deliverable: specific test names, target files, setup/fixtures, assertions, dry-run or environment isolation strategy, and why each catches a migration regression; distinguish tests feasible offline from environment-dependent checks and recommend the smallest high-value set. Validation: verify every proposal against existing public/internal APIs and helper capabilities; include file/line evidence and unresolved gaps. Output artifact: /tmp/pacsea-migration-test-matrix.md. Stop and escalate rather than inventing product, architecture, dependency, migration, security, or ownership decisions.
